_README: REPRESENTATIVE FIXTURE, not a measurement of any candidate this repository builds. The probabilities are commander_simulator's published figures for its own authored list (STATE.md, 60,000 games, list A snapshot 2026-09-01). They are reproduced here so the consumer path has a realistic shape to develop against; the simulator_version is prefixed 'fixture:' on load so nothing renders it as a live run.
measures: turns until a declared pattern is assembled, playing alone with no opponents, no stack, no combat and no interaction
does_not_measure: deck quality, matchups, or whether the deck wins. A faster number is not a better deck.
